spec.title: Ingest p5 per run
spec.description: Each point is one run's sustained ingest p5, the highest rate at least 95% of its steady windows held, at the time the run finished. One colour per instance type. Every run in the time range and the selected series is here, whatever its class; the table below gives the class.

spec.title: Ingest median per run
spec.description: Each point is one run's median ingest rate over its steady windows, at the time the run finished. One colour per instance type.

spec.title: Objects written per second
spec.description: Each point is one run's median count of objects written per second over its steady windows, at the time the run finished. One colour per instance type.

spec.title: Recent runs
spec.description: One row per run in the time range, newest first. p5 and median are the drill's sustained ingest rates, windows the count of steady windows behind them, and class the record's outcome. A run whose drill never ran sends no results and has no row. Click a run ID to search Tempo for its spans; only traced runs have any.

spec.expr: max by (run_id, box, instance_type, tier, series, class, traced, workers, size_bytes) (last_over_time(forge_perf_sustained_windows{box=~"$box", series=~"$series"}[$__range]))
max by (run_id, box, instance_type, tier, series, class, traced, workers, size_bytes) (last_over_time(forge_perf_ingest_p5_bytes_per_second{box=~"$box", series=~"$series"}[$__range]))
max by (run_id, box, instance_type, tier, series, class, traced, workers, size_bytes) (last_over_time(forge_perf_ingest_median_bytes_per_second{box=~"$box", series=~"$series"}[$__range]))
max by (run_id, box, instance_type, tier, series, class, traced, workers, size_bytes) (last_over_time(forge_perf_writes_per_second{box=~"$box", series=~"$series"}[$__range]))

value.title: Search Tempo for this run's spans

spec.title: Read-back p5 per run
spec.description: Each point is one run's read-back p5, the highest rate at least 95% of its steady windows held, at the time the run finished. Read-back is one GET of each whole blob 30 to 60 seconds after it was written, served from ingot's local spool. One colour per instance type. Runs before the harness recorded it have no point.

spec.title: Read-back median per run
spec.description: Each point is one run's median read-back rate over its steady windows, at the time the run finished. One colour per instance type.

spec.title: Restore p5 per run
spec.description: Each point is one run's restore p5, the highest rate at least 95% of its steady windows held, at the time the run finished. Restore is workers reading older blobs in block-sized ranges, served from ingot's local spool. One colour per instance type. Runs before the harness recorded it have no point.

spec.title: Restore median per run
spec.description: Each point is one run's median restore rate over its steady windows, at the time the run finished. One colour per instance type.

spec.title: Restore ranged GETs per second
spec.description: Each point is one run's median count of ranged GETs per second over its steady windows, at the time the run finished. Only restore sends ranged GETs. One colour per instance type. Runs before the harness recorded it have no point.
